description: Return one self-contained JavaScript snippet (Web Audio, ~7 KB, no dependencies, no audio files) that defines play functions for several sounds. Best for browser games: paste it in and call e.g. playCoin() after a user gesture. Each sound is either {name, preset, seed} or {name, patch}.

name.description: Used for the function name, e.g. "coin" -> playCoin()

seed.description: Seed from generate_sfx to get the same sound; random if omitted

name: get_js_code
title: Get drop-in JavaScript for sounds
